# Business: bounded synthetic-evidence assessment

This is fictional teaching evidence, not Apple facts. Economic cutoff: 2024-08-31 UTC. The only supplied narrative was available 2024-05-03; no later-period coverage is established.

Source: investing/assets/equities/aapl/data/original-extract.json, Business, MD&A, Risk factors; metadata: data/sources/narrative.json. Services renewals support recurring revenue, while hardware demand is cyclical. Units fell 5% and services grew 8%; these measure different bases and cannot be netted into 3% overall growth. Currency and mix changed too, so volume alone does not explain revenue. No revenue weights, margins or price/volume bridge permit quantification.

Counterevidence: distribution concentration and possible antitrust remedies could impair service margins, so recurring revenue does not prove durable profitability. Missing financial notes, governance/proxy and the filing remainder prevent a full business or management assessment. Verify those before elevating this limited extract reading into an investment thesis.

Applied local method: method-v1, actually authored 2026-11-16, retrospective reconstruction rather than a contemporaneous 2024 method. No calibrated return model. This question records only what the supplied narrative supports; broader research gaps remain pending.

import sys,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'/private/tmp/finance-research-continuation/obsidian-finance/scripts')
import research_store as store
root=Path('/private/tmp/finance-skill-trials/missing-baseline-3')
out=Path('/private/tmp/finance-skill-trials/outputs/missing-baseline-3')
cutoff='2024-08-31T23:59:59+00:00'
expected=store.publication_snapshot(root)
before=store.discover(root,'latest',cutoff)
(out/'before.json').write_text(json.dumps(before,indent=2))
base='investing/assets/equities/aapl'
old=json.loads((root/base/'cycles/2024Q2/2024-05-03-r1/review.json').read_text())
source=json.loads((root/base/'data/sources/narrative.json').read_text())
method=json.loads((root/base/'data/analysis/method.json').read_text())
text='''# Business: bounded synthetic-evidence assessment

This is fictional teaching evidence, not Apple facts. Economic cutoff: 2024-08-31 UTC. The only supplied narrative was available 2024-05-03; no later-period coverage is established.

Source: investing/assets/equities/aapl/data/original-extract.json, Business, MD&A, Risk factors; metadata: data/sources/narrative.json. Services renewals support recurring revenue, while hardware demand is cyclical. Units fell 5% and services grew 8%; these measure different bases and cannot be netted into 3% overall growth. Currency and mix changed too, so volume alone does not explain revenue. No revenue weights, margins or price/volume bridge permit quantification.

Counterevidence: distribution concentration and possible antitrust remedies could impair service margins, so recurring revenue does not prove durable profitability. Missing financial notes, governance/proxy and the filing remainder prevent a full business or management assessment. Verify those before elevating this limited extract reading into an investment thesis.

Applied local method: method-v1, actually authored 2026-11-16, retrospective reconstruction rather than a contemporaneous 2024 method. No calibrated return model. This question records only what the supplied narrative supports; broader research gaps remain pending.
'''
digest=hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()
target=base+'/cycles/2024Q2/2024-08-31-r2'
unit={'consumed':{'narrative':{'version':source['identity'],'projection':source['projection']}},'analysis_inputs':{'method':{'kind':method['kind'],'version':method['identity'],'authored_at':method['authored_at'],'projection':method['projection'],'content_ref':method['content_ref'],'content_digest':method['content_digest']}},'output':{'path':target+'/business.md','digest':digest},'verification':target+'/business-check.json'}
gaps=['Missing market source and market scenarios.','Price metadata says USD 10, but raw file contains only raw; no valuation denominator, cash flows, debt, share count or calibrated forecast.','Full filing notes, governance/proxy and remainder absent; no eligible financial-original source establishes updated fiscal coverage.','Legacy valuation output is only analysis; mechanical validity does not substantiate valuation.','Synthesis remains pending on valuation and market scenarios; external freshness unverified.']
horizons={}
for key,duration,judgment,trigger in [('short','0–3 months','insufficient_evidence: no market, catalyst or dated current-price evidence for direction.','Dated market, price and catalyst evidence changes the scenario.'),('medium','3–12 months','insufficient_evidence: renewal support and cyclical hardware create opposing possibilities; growth and margin magnitudes are unknown.','Revenue bridge, service margins and hardware demand resolve the opposing drivers.'),('long','12–60 months','insufficient_evidence: recurring service demand may support durability, but concentration and remedies may erode economics.','Evidence on renewals, competition, regulation, reinvestment and cash returns changes durability assumptions.')]:
    horizons[key]={'judgment':duration+' analytical horizon, not inferred user holding period. '+judgment,'evidence':[base+'/data/original-extract.json',base+'/data/method.md'],'invalidation_triggers':[trigger]}
review={'version':1,'id':'r2','predecessor':'r1','fiscal':old['fiscal'],'cutoff':cutoff,'units':{'business':unit},'research':{'method':'method-v1; bounded qualitative reconstruction; authored 2026-11-16; no calibrated model','assumptions':['Use earlier 0–3/3–12/12–60 month convention for analytical scenarios only; user holding period unknown.','No unavailable economic evidence is inferred.'],'changes':'Replace placeholder-only analysis with bounded narrative work; leave valuation, market and synthesis pending. No new quarter inferred.','gaps':gaps,'horizons':horizons}}
checks={'version':1,'output_digest':digest,'checks':dict.fromkeys(['sources','citations','calculations','counterevidence'],True),'unresolved':[]}
result=store.publish(root,'aapl',review,{'business.md':text,'business-check.json':json.dumps(checks,indent=2),'pending-analysis.md':'# Pending configured questions\n\n'+'\n\n'.join(gaps)+'\n\n'+json.dumps(horizons,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)},expected,'offline-missing-3',complete=False)
(out/'publication.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
after=store.discover(root,'latest',cutoff)
(out/'after.json').write_text(json.dumps(after,indent=2))
unchanged=all(hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for p,h in expected.items())
print(json.dumps({'publication':result,'history_unchanged':unchanged,'assessment':after},indent=2))
